place.zh: 沉鼎观 · 外门 · 执事房
place.en: Chending Temple · The outer court · the steward's office

setup.zh: 你输了，就不能进下一轮。可那天晌午歇场，周衡把你叫进了执事房：「外门大比，有一条规矩。你知道么？」
setup.en: Lose, and you can't go on. But at the midday break Zhou Heng calls you into the stewards' office: "The contest has a rule. Do you know it?"

recap.zh: 你输了第一轮。晌午歇场，周衡从抽屉里一块一块数出十块灵石：巡夜有功——正好买一次「复试」。
recap.en: You lost the first round. At the midday break Zhou Heng counted ten stones out of his drawer: merit on night watch — exactly the price of a second trial.

en: The midday break, the stewards' office.
On the table, that half candle.

story.zh:
小满输了，输了便不能进下一轮，按规矩是这样。可那天晌午歇场的时候，周衡把他叫进了执事房。

执事房的窗纸糊得厚，大白天也暗，桌上点着半根蜡烛——周衡的蜡烛向来只点半根，另外半根掰下来收在抽屉里，他说点一半，省一半，一个月下来，便省出半个月的亮来。周衡头也不抬，道：「沈小满。」

小满说：「在。」

周衡道：「外门大比，有一条规矩，你知道么？」

小满说：「不知道。」

周衡道：「输了第一轮的，可以花十块灵石，买一次『复试』。」

小满吃了一惊：「……十块？」

周衡道：「外门的规矩。设了三十年，一回都没人用过。」说到这里，他才抬起头来看他，「因为输了第一轮的人，一般都没有十块灵石。」

小满说：「我也没有。」

周衡道：「我知道。」
story.en:
Xiaoman had lost, and a loser can't go on to the next round — so the rules said. But at the midday break that day, Zhou Heng called him into the stewards' office.

The office's window paper was pasted thick; it was dim even in daylight, and on the table burned half a candle — Zhou Heng only ever burned half a candle, the other half broken off and kept in a drawer; burn half, save half, he said, and at the end of a month you've saved half a month of light. Without looking up, Zhou Heng said, "Shen Xiaoman."

"Here."

"The outer court contest has a rule. Do you know it?"

"No."

"One who loses the first round may pay ten spirit stones to buy a 'second trial.'"

Xiaoman was startled. "…Ten?"

"Outer court rule. Set thirty years ago; nobody's ever used it." Only now did he look up. "Because those who lose the first round generally don't have ten spirit stones."

"I don't either," said Xiaoman.

"I know," said Zhou Heng.

story.zh:
他拉开抽屉，从里头拿出一样东西放在桌上——正是那掰下来的半根蜡烛。跟着翻开账簿，拿指头点着一行一行往下念：「十月初十起，药园巡夜，两个月。灵草，一株没丢。按外门的规矩，巡夜有功，赏灵石——」他从抽屉里一块一块地往外数，数一块，拿笔在账上划一道，「——一、二、三……十块。」数完了，又道：「记账。」

小满看着桌上那十块灵石，又看看那半根蜡烛，道：「周师兄，巡夜有功赏灵石，这规矩……也是三十年了？」

周衡翻账簿的手停了一停，道：「今年新设的。」

小满没有再问。周衡已低下头去接着翻他的账簿，翻得哗哗直响。小满把灵石揣进怀里，走到门口，回过头来叫了一声：「……周师兄。」

周衡道：「嗯。」

小满说：「有前途。」

周衡翻账簿的手又停了一下，随即咳嗽一声，挥挥手，叫他滚了。小满出了门，听见身后执事房里「咔」的一声轻响，大约是周衡又把那半根蜡烛掰回了抽屉里。
story.en:
He opened the drawer, took out something and set it on the table — that very half candle he'd broken off. Then he opened the ledger and read down it line by line with his finger: "From the tenth of the tenth month, herb-garden night watch, two months. Herbs: not one lost. By outer court rule, merit on night watch is rewarded with spirit stones —" he counted them out of the drawer one at a time, striking a line in the ledger for each, "— one, two, three… ten." When he'd finished he said, "On the books."

Xiaoman looked at the ten stones on the table, then at the half candle. "Brother Zhou, stones for merit on night watch — is that rule thirty years old too?"

Zhou Heng's hand paused on the ledger. "New this year."

Xiaoman asked no more. Zhou Heng had bent to his ledger again, turning pages with a great rustle. Xiaoman put the stones in his coat, went to the door, turned back and called: "…Brother Zhou."

"Mm."

"Promising," said Xiaoman.

Zhou Heng's hand paused once more on the ledger; then he coughed, waved, and told him to get out. Outside the door Xiaoman heard a soft snap from the office behind him — likely Zhou Heng breaking the half candle back into the drawer.
